title: Pal Rap Back
style: Alternative R&B with dembow bounce and handclap-led percussion, syncopated groove, and a quick party swing; verse rides breathy close-mic rap-sung lines, pre-chorus lifts with stacked kid-like high harmonies, chorus drops into chanty gang vocals and playful call-and-response. Ear candy includes clap fills, reversed swells into the hook, and tiny vocal chops between lines. Bright, punchy, and glossy with a humid club sheen., vocal, alternative r&b, breathy, rap, latin
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Thailand on my tongue
Clap-clap on the floor
Rap pal dot app
Say it once, say it more

You got that?
I want that bounce
Talk it sweet, talk it loud
Spin me round and round

[Pre-Chorus]
Pal, pal, don't stop
Feet go left, then right
Be my song, pal
Keep me in the light

Song pal dot a i
Sing me up again
When I lean breathy low
You come back with "yeah"

[Chorus]
Rappal.app
Rap back, pal
Rappal.app
Dance back, pal

Pal dot dance
Go to pal dot dance
Pal dot dance
Now take my hand

[Verse 2]
Latin America pal
Heat on the tiles
Kiss that clap pattern
Let it run a while

Alternative R&B
With a dancer's sway
High vocals kiss the air
Then break away

Comuter voces
Kid in the hook
Slam my name once
Then give me that look

[Pre-Chorus]
Pal, pal, don't stop
Feet go left, then right
Be my song, pal
Keep me in the light

Songpal.ai
Sing me up again
When I lean breathy low
You come back with "yeah"

[Chorus]
Rappal.app
Rap back, pal
Rappal.app
Dance back, pal

Pal dot dance
Go to pal dot dance
Pal dot dance
Now take my hand

[Bridge]
Clap on my chest
Then pull away
Breathy little danger
In the words you say

Sing everwhere
Let it bend, let it ring
One more high voice
And we start to swing

[Final Chorus]
Rappal.app
Rap back, pal
Rappal.app
Dance back, pal

Pal dot dance
Go to pal dot dance
Pal dot dance
Now take my hand
